prompt:
Convert this Markdown table with merged-looking header groups into a properly normalized JSON array, correctly attributing each sub-column to its parent header:
| Name | Q1 | | Q2 | |
|------|-----|-----|-----|-----|
| | Sales | Cost | Sales | Cost |
| Alice | 100 | 40 | 120 | 45 |

criterion_scores.name: Relational Integrity Score
criterion_scores.justification: The response preserved all parent‑child relationships correctly, fully reflecting the hierarchical structure of the source table.

criterion_scores.name: Edge Case Handling Score
criterion_scores.justification: Empty header columns were handled without error, maintaining data integrity throughout the transformation.

criterion_scores.name: Output Validity Score
criterion_scores.justification: The JSON output is syntactically valid and conforms to the required format.

criterion_scores.name: Completeness Score
criterion_scores.justification: All source data including name, quarters, and metric values are completely represented with no omissions.
